mode.name: Last Stand
mode.description: Hold the base against waves of creatures

markers.label: Base
markers.description: The room the team holds. Enemies inside it with no defender near overrun it. Without one, the base is a circle round the CT spawns (lst_base_radius).

markers.label: Armory
markers.description: Where players press USE for repair kits, armor, grenades and ammo; the shopkeeper stands here. A func_buyzone named lst_shop works too. Without one, the armory is the base.

markers.label: Defender spot
markers.description: A raised spot bots like to hold (a firing step, a walkway). Without any, raised floor behind each gate is found by itself.

markers.label: Perk station
markers.description: Buy one perk here (lasts until you go down; 4 at most, each dearer). One station per perk; without any, perks are in the armory menu.

markers.label: Upgrade bench
markers.description: Upgrade the gun in hand to Mk II, later Mk III. Without one, the armory menu does it.

markers.label: Electric trap
markers.description: Pay to switch on for 30 s: hurts creatures in the area hard, players a little. Put it in front of a gate, the area across the way in.

markers.label: Mystery box spot
markers.description: Where the mystery box can be (a random gun for a price). It moves between the spots after a few uses; 2-3 spots work best.

components.note: Where creatures come in, out of sight of the base. Without one, waves start at the T spawn.
Gates: a CLIP brush (or size) with boards=<its boards' name> and label=<gate name> for the gates list.
Open ground near the base where supply crates land every few waves.
Optional guns lying in or near the base.

notes: One base the CTs defend, two to four ways in. Put gates (barricades) on the ways in: bullets pass the gaps between boards, creatures and players don't. Spawners far enough out that a wave takes 10-20 s to arrive. A nav mesh is needed (the bots and creatures walk it). Every CT spawn should be inside  Upgrades: perk stations, an upgrade bench in the armory, a trap at each gate and 2-3 mystery box spots.
